    Detailing, done in the right order.

    Paint has to be clean before it can be corrected, and corrected before it is protected. Skipping a step locks the dirt in.

    Exterior Detailing

    • Clay bar
    • Iron decontamination
    • Paint correction
    • Chrome restoration
    • All glass
    • Protection
    BOOK EXTERIOR

    Interior Detailing

    BOOK INTERIOR

    How paint gets its gloss back

    1. Premium wash

      Loose dirt comes off first, so nothing gets dragged across the paint later.

    2. Asphalt removal

      Tar, bug stains and cement splatter are dissolved instead of scrubbed.

    3. Iron decontamination

      Embedded brake dust and iron particles are chemically released from the clear coat.

    4. Clay bar treatment

      Bonded contamination is lifted until the paint feels smooth as glass.

    5. Paint correction

      Machine buffing removes swirl marks and acid rain etching.

    6. Graphene protection

      A graphene seal locks in the finish and makes water bead and roll off.

    Why drivers choose BZONE.

    Simple reasons. We do the work properly, and we show you the price before we start.

    Professional detailers

    Our own in-house crew handles every car, from a Premium Wash to full paint correction.

    Quality-focused service

    A car leaves the bay when it's done right, not when the timer runs out.

    Proper detailing procedures

    Wash, decontaminate, correct, then protect. The order matters and we follow it.

    Premium products

    Graphene seal, ceramic wax and carnauba paste wax, chosen for gloss and protection.

    Attention to detail

    Door jambs, wheel faces, mats and glass edges get cleaned, not skipped.

    Customer-focused service

    Clear prices by vehicle size, walk-ins or bookings, and easy rescheduling.
